changes.title: refactor(lk): use the shared plateau option instead of platoo_epochs

hunks.context: #### Deliberate design decisions worth carrying forward

lines.content: - `som` samples a noisy signal (one random city per epoch), so detection can lag by one interval. The
interval scales with `n` and is capped so the stop can always fire.
- **`lin_kernighan` migration** to the shared option: it uses `platoo_epochs` (default 10 via
`LKOptions::default`, validated nowhere) as a *restart* threshold, which is what `stagnation_epochs`
- **`lin_kernighan` migration** to the shared option: it uses `platoo_epochs` (default 10 via
`LKOptions::default`, validated nowhere) as a *restart* threshold, which is what `stagnation_epochs`
now expresses. Deferred because the two options have different defaults and the CLI flag is
`--plateau_epochs`, so moving LK over changes its default path unless the threshold is preserved
- `docs/algorithms/lin-kernighan.md` still describes `platoo_epochs`; it should be updated with that
migration rather than separately, since the two describe the same option.
The `lin_kernighan` migration moved to `tasks/bench-lk-use-shared-plateau-option`: it is not wiring but
a change to a delivered default (`platoo_epochs` defaults to 10 where `stagnation_epochs` defaults to
0), so it needs its own compatibility decision rather than riding along with this work.

changes.title: feat(tsp): shared plateau stop for all iterative solvers
